The full full-stack framework for Rust

Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack apps. It prioritizes simplicity and productivity. See Learn Topcoat to get started, or the Roadmap for what's coming next.

Early-stage and experimental. Expect breaking changes.

# What makes Topcoat different

# Client reactivity without the boilerplate

Topcoat renders all markup on the server: components can be async and query the database directly, eliminating all the traditional boilerplate needed for a separate API layer. Interactivity does not have to cost a round-trip, though. A $(...) expression is ordinary type-checked Rust that Topcoat evaluates on the server for the initial render and also translates to JavaScript, so it re-runs instantly in the browser. No wasm bundle, no client build step:

# Universal Android Debloater Next Generation

> DISCLAIMER: Use at your own risk. We're not responsible for anything that could happen to your devices.

This is a detached fork of the UAD project. This aims to improve privacy and efficiency (energy, speed, memory) by removing unnecessary and obscure system apps. This can also improve security by reducing the attack surface. Read the wiki for more details.

# Documentation

Everything about UAD-ng (and related stuff) can be found on the Wiki, such as:

• Features of this app

• Suggested Android app replacements

• How to get the cutting-edge version by building the source-code

• Weird things OEMs do

• Suggested apps for analyzing APKs

# Privacy

UAD-ng does not collect or transmit any user data. The only external connections are GET requests to GitHub for fetching the package list (crates/uad-core/src/uad_lists.rs) and checking for updates (crates/uad-core/src/update.rs).

The batteries-included agent harness.

Deep Agents is an open source agent harness — an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece.

• Opinionated — defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work

• Extensible — override or replace any piece without forking

• Model-agnostic — works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local

• Production-ready — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith

• Sub-agents — delegate tasks to agents with isolated context windows

• Filesystem — read, write, edit, or search over pluggable local, sandboxed, or remote backends

• Context management — summarize long threads and offload tool outputs to disk

• Shell access — run commands in your sandbox of choice

• Persistent memory — pluggable state and store backends for cross-session recall

The open-source browser API for AI agents & apps. The best way to build live web agents and browser automation tools.

Steel.dev is an open-source browser API that makes it easy to build AI apps and agents that interact with the web. Instead of building automation infrastructure from scratch, you can focus on your AI application while Steel handles the complexity.

Under the hood, it manages sessions, pages, and browser processes, allowing you to perform complex browsing tasks programmatically without any of the headaches:

• Full Browser Control: Uses Puppeteer and CDP for complete control over Chrome instances -- allowing you to connect using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium.

• Session Management: Maintains browser state, cookies, and local storage across requests

• Proxy Support: Built-in proxy chain management for IP rotation

• Extension Support: Load custom Chrome extensions for enhanced functionality

repos.description: AI-guided editable scientific figures with Codex and local Origin/OriginPro
repos.readme_excerpt:
把表格交给 Codex，把可编辑的科研图带回 Origin 理解数据 · 选择表达 · 定制样式 · 检查交付 三步开始 · 看图选模板 · 复制提示词 · 完整教程 · English

我做 EditaPlot，是想少花一些时间反复调图，多留一些时间讨论数据本身。你把表格和想表达的问题告诉 Codex，它会先说明每列的用途，等你确认后，再调用本机 Origin 绘图和检查结果。

它是一个 Codex Skill，不是独立绘图软件。你仍然可以在 Origin 中继续编辑曲线、坐标轴和图例；配色、线宽与版式也可以在已支持的范围内按你的需求调整。

使用前提：Windows 10/11 x64 实体电脑 + Codex + 本机 Origin/OriginPro。 日常使用不需要提前打开 Origin；Mac、Linux、WSL 和虚拟机暂不支持。

按实际列展示背景、包络和组分，不补造缺失峰。 同时看组间分布和每个观测，而不只看一根柱子。 使用上游已提供的逐样本 SHAP；绘图层不训练模型。 保留全部 900 个源值与行列顺序，不插值、不自动聚类。

repos.readme_excerpt:
# 设备电量查看器

Windows 上读取 2.4G 无线外设电量的小工具。纯 ctypes 调系统 DLL，零第三方依赖—— 不用 hidapi、不用 pystray、不用 Pillow、不用 pywin32，装了 Python 就能跑。

# ⚠️ 只支持这两台设备

这不是一个通用工具。协议是逆向我们这两台具体设备得到的——换成别的鼠标或耳机， 大概率一个字节都读不出来（界面会显示「没有可用的读取方式」）。

你的设备不在这两行里？ 别硬改这个仓库，往下看「用 prompt 做一份你自己的」。

# 使用方法

面板里会显示两台设备的电量，默认自动刷新，底部可以改刷新间隔。

• 想摸新设备的协议：python app.py —— 完整调试版，可枚举接口、转储 Feature Report、探测 Report ID、手动标定

# 用 prompt 做一份你自己的

这套东西的价值不在代码，在方法。下面这段 prompt 把我做这个工具的全过程和结论都写进去了， 交给一个能动手的 Agent 就能按你自己的设备重做一份。

> 这不是「写点代码」的活：要枚举本机 HID 接口、抓真实报文、试发命令、爆破 CRC、 > 再到真机上验证——每一步都得实际在这台电脑上跑起来。 > 纯聊天窗口只能给你一段猜出来的代码；能执行命令、能读写文件的 Agent 才调得通。

• 复制下面折叠块里的 prompt（或直接打开 PROMPT.md）

• 贴给一个 Agent：WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy / Cursor / Claude Code 这类都行（关键是要能执行命令、读写文件）

• 换成你的设备：把 prompt 里「要读的两台设备」那一段替换掉。

不知道 VID/PID 就这样查：设备管理器 → 右键设备 → 属性 → 详细信息 → 硬件 Id，

• 让它跑通：Agent 会给出一套初始实现。如果读不到电量，让它用完整版的

「原始探测 + 手动标定」把真实协议摸出来，再把结果补回 prompt 的协议段

prompt 里已经写好了硬性约束、协议模板、7 条会踩的坑和验收标准，照做基本不会返工。

repos.description: Things to do after installing Fedora 45
repos.readme_excerpt:
# Fedora 45 Post Install Guide

Things to do after installing Fedora 45

# RPM Fusion

• Fedora has disabled the repositories for a lot of free and non-free .rpm packages by default. Follow this if you want to use non-free software like Steam, Discord and some multimedia codecs etc. As a general rule of thumb it is advised to do this to get access to many mainstream useful programs.

• Enable third party repositories by pasting the following into the terminal:

• sudo dnf install https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/free/fedora/rpmfusion-free-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/nonfree/fedora/rpmfusion-nonfree-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm

• also while you're at it, install app-stream metadata by:

• sudo dnf install -y rpmfusion-free-appstream-data rpmfusion-nonfree-appstream-data

# Update

• Go into the software center and click on update. Alternatively, you can do:

• sudo dnf -y update

# OpenMM: A High Performance Molecular Dynamics Library

# Introduction

OpenMM is a toolkit for molecular simulation. It can be used either as a stand-alone application for running simulations, or as a library you call from your own code. It provides a combination of extreme flexibility (through custom forces and integrators), openness, and high performance (especially on recent GPUs) that make it truly unique among simulation codes.

repos.description: Protein and molecule viewer, editor, simulator
repos.readme_excerpt:
# Molchanica

# Launch or open a GROMACS run. Inspect it in 3D. Share a view your lab can reopen.

# Design protein backbones, run structure and sequence prediction with an integrated, visual-first pipeline.

Molchanica is a molecule visualization, editing, and computation tool. It combines functionality found in PyMol, Chimera, Coot, VMD, GROMACS, and Avogadro, and operates with the focus on visualizing molecules over time and space. Any molecule you open or build can move using molecular dynamics. It integrates with machine-learning tools for protein engineering, including RFDiffusion3, Boltz-2, OpenDDE, ProteinMPNN, and Chai-1.

Molchanica includes Computer Aided Drug Design (CADD) tools. For example, molecule screening and generation based on pharmacophores, machine-learning from empirical binding data and more. It estimates ADME and toxicity parameters using a neural network trained on Therapeutic data commons (TDC) data.

# tauri-ui

> ⚡ Scaffold Tauri desktop apps with shadcn/ui and desktop-ready defaults.

Choose Vite, Next.js, React Router, Astro, or TanStack Start. Upstream CLIs build the foundation; tauri-ui adds the native shell and optional batteries.

# Get started

> Each release includes a demo build showing the expected output — available in Releases.

# After scaffold

• swap icons: bunx tauri icon ./app-icon.png

• add shadcn components: bunx shadcn@latest add dialog sonner

• add tauri plugins: bun run tauri add store (plugin list)

• batteries live in src/components/ (debug-panel, external-link-guard, theme-provider)

• tweak window defaults in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json

• CLI flags + opt-outs → packages/create-tauri-ui

# 🔋 Batteries Included

• no startup flash (hidden until first paint)

• external links open in system browser

• no overscroll / rubber-band scrolling

• sensible default window size and position

• smaller binary output (~65% smaller binary in our test)

The batteries-included agent harness.

Deep Agents is an agent harness. An opinionated, ready-to-run agent out of the box. Instead of wiring prompts, tools, and context management yourself, you get a working agent immediately and customize what you need.

• Planning — write_todos for task breakdown and progress tracking

• Filesystem — read_file, write_file, edit_file, ls, glob, grep for working memory

• Sub-agents — task for delegating work with isolated context windows

• Smart defaults — built-in prompt and middleware that make these tools useful out of the box

• Context management — file-based workflows to keep long tasks manageable

> Looking for the Python package? See langchain-ai/deepagents.
